name: @punchact/dsh-rpc
description: Loopback JSON-RPC bridge that lets local AI agents drive DeepSeek Harness sessions

scripts.check:version: node --input-type=module -e "import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs'; const {PLUGIN_VERSION} = await import('./lib/version.mjs'); const v = JSON.parse(readFileSync('package.json','utf8')).version; if (PLUGIN_VERSION !== v) { console.error('PLUGIN_VERSION ' + PLUGIN_VERSION + ' != package.json ' + v); process.exit(1); } console.log('version ok: ' + v);"
